scope.evidence_limits: Strong-reference and disposal-order assertions in Node; not a reachability measurement, driver-allocation proof, memory-leak proof, pixel comparison, or FPS acceptance

hash_scope: SHA-256 of actual captured working-tree file bytes. These are not claims about normalized Git LF byte digests. Recursive evidence -text attributes preserve copied raw bytes.

defect.reference_path: runs[i] -> mesh.material.uniforms.uiTexture.value -> retired Texture -> CPU image/canvas source
defect.trigger: Composition shrinks or becomes empty; dedicated text/image map entry is disposed/deleted but inactive run is only hidden
defect.scope: Engine-held source reference, bounded by historical reusable-run peak; not by itself proof of retained native/GPU allocations or unbounded growth

correction.binding_ownership: Private Texture -> Set<run> index; detach affected sampler/map references before retirement, and bind inactive runs to the shared white texture
correction.complexity: Retirement visits actual run borrowers, avoiding a scan of every run for every retired texture
correction.reuse: Keep reusable geometry/material capacity and active/shared A/B/A texture ownership
correction.dedicated_failure: Paint replacement first; a first replacement-raster exception preserves the preceding sampler and texture
correction.failure_limit: No new all-or-nothing rollback promise for arbitrary later GPU/allocation/disposal failures
correction.atlas: Existing page/slot cache lifetime remains; hidden borrowers detach while valid cached pages remain, and context cleanup retires pages
correction.broker: GPU texture retirement does not close image pixels; real broker leases remain ready until their separate owners release them

negative.note: Captured before production edits. Two more coverage cases were subsequently added to the final test source.

full.scope: Full regenerated web + scripts colocated Node suite, explicitly including the then-untracked new ownership test
full.command_provenance: Root reported the actual full gate; raw output is preserved. Exact shell invocation was not included in that raw stdout and is not reconstructed here.
full.skip_reason_scope: Skipped cases remain visible in the raw log and are not claimed as executed passes

ownership_case_names: shrinking UI runs detach retired image/dedicated samplers while preserving active ownership
an empty UI composition clears every old sampler even when no new render call occurs
next reuse preserves reusable geometry/materials and binds only newly live textures
shared A/B/A runs detach only the hidden borrower and preserve the still-live A sampler
hidden atlas borrowers detach without evicting cached text; context loss retires the page once
a failed dedicated text raster leaves its preceding complete sampler and texture alive
clear detaches all sampler references before physical texture disposal
contextLost detaches all sampler references before physical texture disposal
dispose detaches all sampler references before physical texture disposal
